name: Geoff Baum
office: Pasadena Area Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Geoff Baum is an educator and former Pasadena Area Community College District trustee. He served 12 years on the California Community Colleges Board of Governors, twice as president. As president, he oversaw the 2015 approval of the state's first community college bachelor's degrees. His campaign says he wants trades training for fire recovery, free-textbook pathways, plain-English bond summaries before votes, and dual enrollment at every district high school.
